method: Applied the only sourcing move that worked twice this week — hunt for high-engagement manual how-to tutorials, because a popular tutorial is proof the product does not exist — to a mass consumer scene instead of a craft niche. Searched Xiaohongshu for 求分解 镜像 舞蹈 / 扒舞 / 求慢速分解 / 跳舞镜像分不清左右 / 扒舞app推荐, read the comment sections of the highest-engagement posts, then checked what the existing 扒舞 apps actually do.
gap: The existing 扒舞 apps are speed / mirror / frame-step / loop players — 终于有工具可以逐帧练舞了 (354 likes), 小众APP｜跳舞人必备扒舞APP (412), plus individuals building their own (习舞一年，我做了一个新手练舞专用 App). Not one of them understands what is happening in the frame: no automatic eight-count splitting, no cues, no feedback on your own body, and none of them can produce the back-facing view everybody actually wants. Mirroring is one line of code and was never the hard part — mirroring flips the clothes, the room and the face too, which is precisely why teachers film a separate back-view take.

zh.pain: 刷到一支想学的舞，却学不会：全速、正面机位、没有拍数，也没人肯为你重跳一遍慢的。
zh.kill: 抖音和快手同时握着视频和姿态模型，把变速＋分段做成播放器功能随时可以。真正的风险在口令：说反一次左右就比不给还糟，因为这批人靠肌肉记忆，错动作练进去要花更久改回来。而单目视频合成背面视角仍属研究阶段，所以第一版绝不能承诺它。
zh.move: 别再做播放器，做老师手工在做的那件事：切到八拍、放慢、把每一拍身体在干什么说出来；每条口令都能点回它自己那一帧，机器不确定就留空而不是硬猜。只在本机处理用户自己找到的视频，永不托管、永不再分发。冷启动（中文）：那几条慢速教程本身的评论区（6909／4667／2979／2727赞）挤满了在求某一支歌慢速版的人，再加「扒舞好累啊」「什么app比较适合扒舞」两个搜索词落地的笔记；冷启动（英文）：YouTube dance tutorial 底下常年的 mirrored version please，以及 r/kpophelp。
zh.hook: 刷到一支想学的舞却学不会的人：全速、正面机位、没有拍数。需求量在供给侧就能量出来——慢速分解笔记本身就是流量（6909／4667／2979／2727 赞），评论区是一支排着队求「这一首的慢版」的队伍，因为肯为你重跳一遍慢的老师只有那一个。
zh.does: 在你自己找到的那段视频上本地跑：自动切八拍、放慢，并逐拍说出身体做什么——每句口令都能点回它自己那一帧，模型没把握的拍留空、不猜。
zh.counter: 抖音和快手同时坐在视频和姿态模型上，变速＋分段随时可以做成播放器的一个功能。口令生成才是真风险：把左说成右比没用更糟，因为这群人靠肌肉记忆，错动作改起来比学起来还久。背面视角的单机位合成还在研究阶段，第一版绝不能承诺。
zh.differentiator: 现存扒舞 App 全是播放器——变速／镜像／逐帧／循环——没有一个看得懂画面里发生了什么；镜像只有一行代码，从来不是难点，而且它会把衣服、房间和脸一起翻过去。冷启动（中文）：慢速分解笔记自己的评论区，以及「扒舞好累啊」「什么app比较适合扒舞」两个搜索。冷启动（英文）：r/Dance 与 TikTok 舞蹈教程的评论区。
zh.consumer_angle: 在家跟着视频学舞的普通人。她拿走的是一份切好八拍、带口令的分解，今晚就能跟着练——不是一个更好用的播放器。

pain: Someone who saved a dance off their feed and cannot learn it: full speed, filmed from the front, no counts, and nobody willing to re-dance it slowly for them.
kill: Douyin and Kuaishou sit on both the videos and the pose models and could ship speed + segmentation as a player feature. Cue generation is the real risk: say 'left' when it is right and you are worse than useless, because this audience trains by muscle memory and a wrong move takes longer to unlearn than to learn. And back-view synthesis from a single camera is still research, so version one must not promise it.
move: Do not build another player — build the thing a teacher does by hand: cut to the eight-count, slow it, and say out loud what the body does on each count, with every cue clickable back to its own frame and left blank rather than guessed when the model is unsure. Local-only on a video the user already found; never host, never redistribute. Cold start (Chinese): the comment sections under the slow-tutorial posts themselves (6,909 / 4,667 / 2,979 / 2,727 likes) are full of people asking for a slow version of one specific song, plus the notes that land on the searches 扒舞好累啊 and 什么app比较适合扒舞. Cold start (English): the 'mirrored version please' comments under YouTube dance tutorials, and r/kpophelp.
hook: Someone who saved a dance off their feed and cannot learn it: full speed, front-facing, no counts. The demand is measured on the supply side — slow-breakdown notes are themselves the traffic (6,909 / 4,667 / 2,979 / 2,727 likes) and their comment sections are a queue asking for the slow version of one specific song, because only one teacher is willing to dance it again slowly.
does: Runs locally on a video you already found: splits it into eight-counts, slows it, and says out loud what the body does on each count — every cue clickable back to its own frame, and left blank rather than guessed when the model is unsure.
counter: Douyin and Kuaishou sit on both the videos and the pose models and could ship speed plus segmentation as a player feature. Cue generation is the real risk: say 'left' when it is right and you are worse than useless, because this audience trains by muscle memory and a wrong move takes longer to unlearn than to learn. Back-view synthesis from a single camera is still research, so version one must not promise it.
differentiator: Every existing 扒舞 app is a player — speed, mirror, frame-step, loop — and not one understands what is happening in the frame; mirroring is one line of code and was never the hard part, and it flips the clothes, the room and the face too.
